meta.promptText: India mein acne wali skin ke liye 700 rupees ke andar konsa serum kharidun?

response.text:
India mein acne aur oily skin ke liye 700 rupees ke andar kai behtareen serums available hain. Acne ke liye sabse acche serums wo hote hain jinme **Salicylic Acid (BHA)** ya **Niacinamide** ho, kyunki ye pores ko saaf karte hain aur oil control karte hain.

700 rupees ke budget mein aap in top-rated options me se koi ek chun sakte hain:

### 1. Minimalist 2% Salicylic Acid Face Serum

* **Price:[www.nykaa.com](https://www.nykaa.com/dp/salicylic-acid-serum#:~:text=%E2%82%B9749%E2%82%B959920%25%20Off.%20Price%20dropped%20by%20%E2%82%B937.%20Minimalist.,PAD%20Epigenetic%20Tech.%202%20Sizes.%20%E2%82%B92450.%20Minimalist.)** Approx.[www.purplle.com](https://www.purplle.com/collections/serum-essence-salicylic-acid-serum-and-essence#:~:text=Shop%20All%20Products%20*%204%20offers.%20Minimalist,-%2010%20ml.%20%E2%82%B9237%20%E2%82%B9249%205%25%20off.) ₹549 (30ml)[www.nykaa.com](https://www.nykaa.com/dp/salicylic-acid-serum#:~:text=The%20Derma%20Co.%202%25%20Salicylic%20Acid%20Face,Unclogs%20Pores.%202%20Sizes.%20%E2%82%B9399%E2%82%B933915%25%20Off.%20Plum.)
* **Kiske liye best hai:** Active acne, blackheads, whiteheads aur oily skin ke liye.
* **Kyu kharidein:** Ye India ke top brands mein se ek hai. Isme Salicylic acid ke sath Aloe vera juice hota hai jo skin ko zyada dry nahi hone deta.

### 2. The Ordinary Salicylic Acid 2% Solution

* **Price:[www.nykaa.com](https://www.nykaa.com/dp/salicylic-acid-serum#:~:text=The%20Derma%20Co.%202%25%20Salicylic%20Acid%20Face,Unclogs%20Pores.%202%20Sizes.%20%E2%82%B9399%E2%82%B933915%25%20Off.%20Plum.)** Approx. ₹600[www.nykaa.com](https://www.nykaa.com/dp/salicylic-acid-serum#:~:text=The%20Derma%20Co.%202%25%20Salicylic%20Acid%20Face,Unclogs%20Pores.%202%20Sizes.%20%E2%82%B9399%E2%82%B933915%25%20Off.%20Plum.)
* **Kiske liye best hai:** Pores ko unclog karne aur blemish-prone skin ke liye.[www.twasa.com](https://www.twasa.com/collections/salicylic-acid-serum#:~:text=With%20regular%20use%2C%20this%20serum%20works%20to,an%20essential%20addition%20to%20your%20skincare%20regime.)
* **Kyu kharidein:** Yeh ek international cult-favorite formula hai jo ab India mein easily 700 ke budget ke andar mil jata hai. Yeh oily aur acne-prone skin par bahut tezi se kaam karta hai.

### 3. The Derma Co. 2% Salicylic Acid Face Serum (ya Sali-Cinamide variant)

* **Price:[www.purplle.com](https://www.purplle.com/collections/serum-essence-salicylic-acid-serum-and-essence#:~:text=%E2%82%B9206%20%E2%82%B9299%2031%25%20off.%204.2%20%284291%29%2015,15%20gm%2015%20gm%20x%202%20%7C)** Approx. ₹499 - ₹549 (30ml)
* **Kiske liye best hai:** Active pimples aur acne marks ke liye.
* **Kyu kharidein:** Agar aapko pimples ke sath unke daag (marks) ki bhi problem hai, toh inka Sali-Cinamide (Salicylic Acid + Niacinamide) ya standard 2% Salicylic acid serum budget mein ek solid option hai.

### 4. Dot & Key 2% Salicylic + Cica Anti-Acne Face Serum

* **Price:[www.purplle.com](https://www.purplle.com/collections/serum-essence-salicylic-acid-serum-and-essence#:~:text=%E2%82%B9206%20%E2%82%B9299%2031%25%20off.%204.2%20%284291%29%2015,15%20gm%2015%20gm%20x%202%20%7C)** Approx.[www.purplle.com](https://www.purplle.com/collections/serum-essence-salicylic-acid-serum-and-essence#:~:text=%E2%82%B9206%20%E2%82%B9299%2031%25%20off.%204.2%20%284291%29%2015,15%20gm%2015%20gm%20x%202%20%7C) ₹399 - ₹450
* **Kiske liye best hai:** Sensitive aur acne-prone skin, jisme redness ya irritation hoti ho.
* **Kyu kharidein:** Isme Salicylic acid ke sath **Cica (Centella Asiatica)** hota hai, jo acne ki vajah se hone wali redness aur inflammation ko turant soothe (shant) karta hai.

---

### Khareedte waqt kuch zaroori baatein:

* **Patch Test:** Koi bhi naya serum use karne se pehle kahanai ya kaan ke pichhe laga kar 24 ghante check zaroor karein ki skin ko suit ho raha hai ya nahi.
* **Sunscreen:[www.flipkart.com](https://www.flipkart.com/beauty-and-grooming/body-face-skin-care/body-and-face-care/face-serums/pr?sid=g9b,ema,5la,8um#:~:text=Pilgrim%2010%25%20Niacinamide%20Face%20Serum%20for%20Men,C%20Serum%20For%20Skin%20%7C%20Face%20Serum.)** Agar aap acne serums (khaaskar Salicylic acid) ka use kar rahe hain, toh din mein ek acha Sunscreen lagana bilkul na bhulein.
